verdict.rationale: PostHog explicitly markets AI-generated insight/suggestion capabilities inside the product (e.g., 'PostHog AI' writing Hog functions, stack-trace analysis with suggested code fixes, and 'researched reports and pull requests' from product signals), but a hands-on community report describes trying the in-product LLM feature to build a SQL-based cohort and having it fail outright while severely degrading performance, directly contradicting the polished vendor narrative. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that AI-generated insights work reliably in typical use, resolution/acknowledgement of the reported failure, and more concrete examples of successful AI-suggested insights beyond docs marketing.
